prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: Fanggu heritage monument line plate. Image 1 is a documentary photograph of the ACTUAL 951 CE five-storey pagoda of Daigo-ji in Kyoto; use it for subject geometry. Image 2 is ONLY the project's fine black ink line style sample, not a building-shape reference. Draw the extant Daigo-ji goju-no-to as a precise architectural illustration, preserving exactly FIVE stacked roof tiers, the top finial, dark timber and central white plaster areas, and the complete square tower from ground base to finial. Use the same view as photo, but omit trees, sky, tourists, signage and surrounding temple. Fine neutral BLACK contours, sparse internal detail, no large shaded masses. Portrait composition, complete tower centered with generous white margin. Perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas inside and outside openings. No shadow, gradient, paper texture, glow, gray wash, crosshatching, checkerboard, transparency, text, labels, frame or watermark.

historical_sources.title: 醍醐寺五重塔（国指定文化財等データベース）
historical_sources.note: 三間五重塔婆・本瓦葺；承平年間計画、天暦6年（952）竣工；昭和29〜34年度解体修理で組物が未完成の三手先と判明；木割太く雄大；国宝1951年（重文1897年）

historical_sources.title: 伽藍（境内案内）
historical_sources.note: 醍醐天皇の冥福のため朱雀天皇起工、村上天皇の天暦5年（951）完成；京都府下最古の木造建造物；内部壁画は日本密教絵画の源流

historical_sources.title: 醍醐寺
historical_sources.publisher: ウィキペディア日本語版（维基百科，二手来源）
historical_sources.note: 応仁の乱で下醍醐は五重塔のみ残存；壁画の空海像は現存最古の肖像；1995年阪神・淡路大震災で漆喰剥落；1994年世界遺産
